trace.command: which noacg; noacg --version; echo "exit=$?"; ls /mnt/session/uploads; which certutil; ls /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ 2>/dev/null

export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio
mkdir -p ~/.pki/nssdb && (certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -N --empty-password 2>/dev/null; for c in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/*.crt; do certutil -d sql:$HOME/.pki/nssdb -A -t C,, -n "$(basename "$c")" -i "$c"; done)
noacg doctor; echo "exit=$?"

export NOACG_URL=https://noacg.studio
noacg scaffold --type scoreboard --design neutral --name "Packages check" --out /workspace/graphic; echo "exit=$?"; ls -la /workspace/graphic
noacg validate /workspace/graphic --screenshots /mnt/session/outputs/shots; echo "exit=$?"; ls -la /mnt/session/outputs/shots 2>/dev/null
